address: 208 Yanyu Road, Jiaojiang, Taizhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: A popular breakfast spot among locals, this simple joint is open every day until noon. The menu covers all Taizhou’s breakfast classics – dim sum, noodles and soups. Ground pork rice is a firm favourite: piping hot sticky rice in broth is topped with a heap of sautéed ground pork. Pancake roll stuffed with shredded omelette, pork and veggies can be pan-fried and crisped up. Mochi-filled egg omelette boasts a soft, stretchy texture.
